name: x_mtts.admin
description: Metro Ticket System Administrator with full CRUD rights over station, route, fare rule, and ticket type master data.

name: x_mtts.approver
description: Station Approver role allowing review and decision-making on assigned booking approval tasks.

name: x_mtts.user
description: Commuter user role allowing catalog booking submission and access to personal booking history.

name: x_mtts.scanner
description: Turnstile and handheld inspector device service role authorized to invoke the ticket verification API and record scan audit events.
